knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Large and sharp objects are cleared by hand before the machine runs, because they can jam the brush roll, block the hose or cause injury.
A cord kept behind the operator and not overstretched avoids trips and damage at the plug and at the machine.
Switch off at the machine, switch off the socket, remove the plug at the plug body, wind the cord, then store the machine in its allocated place.

practicalCriteria: Inspects the cord, plug, hose, filter and container against the checklist before the first pass, observed by the assessor.
Clears a planted large object and a planted sharp object by hand, using gloves for the sharp object, before vacuuming, observed by the assessor.
Completes the switch-off sequence and cord winding, and stores the machine in its allocated place, observed by the assessor.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark, so all three must be correct. Practical competence: assessor sign-off against each practical criterion. A knowledge-check pass does not verify practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation sheet for the pre-use check, clearing step and shut-down
Equipment inspection record for the day
stopWorkCriteria: The machine is used with a damaged cord or plug
The machine is run over a sharp or large object without clearing it
The worker pulls the plug by its cord
